why: Intro to Docker plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-docker.json), 'Logs, exec, stop and remove' (passes: docker ps -a lists no container named web and the nginx image is still there). `docker stop web` prints 'web', exactly what `docker rm web` prints, and the learner moved on without removing it: `docker ps -a` still lists web as 'Exited (0) 8 seconds ago'. The nginx image is there, but the container was only stopped.

step.title: Stop and remove the web container
step.instructions: Stop the container with docker stop web, then remove it with docker rm web (each prints web). docker ps -a should no longer list web, and docker images still lists nginx.
